title: Rewrite the Scroll Lyrics
lyrics:
Verse 1:
Break the chains, rewrite the scroll
History's lies, we take control

Chorus:
Afrobeat rise, voices unite
Fight for the light, into the night
breakdown: Line-by-line: 'Break the chains' symbolizes liberation from oppression. 'Rewrite the scroll' refers to reclaiming narratives.

title: Freedom Pulse Lyrics
lyrics:
Verse 1:
Feel the drum, the freedom pulse
Hearts align, we break the curse

Chorus:
Rasta road, we march as one
Afrobeat, the fight’s begun
breakdown: Line-by-line: 'Freedom pulse' reflects the heartbeat of collective resistance. 'Rasta road' nods to cultural roots of rebellion.

title: Rise Again Lyrics
lyrics:
Verse 1:
From the ashes, we rise again
Truth will shine, through storm and pain

Chorus:
Sing it loud, let justice reign
Afrobeat, our soul’s refrain
breakdown: Line-by-line: 'Rise again' speaks to resilience. 'Justice reign' calls for systemic change.
